stances.note: Commonwealth of Independent States has not written its reading of Moldova; the atlas mirrors Moldova's 'neutral' reading as 'neutral' at low confidence, on the same evidence. Bond and trend are not assessed from this side.

stances_toward.note: Moldova is leaving the CIS: the law denouncing the 1991 agreement and the 1993 charter was voted on 2 Apr 2026 (60 of 101) and promulgated on 6 Apr 2026; the exit takes effect on 8 Apr 2027 (12 months after notification). Moldova has already left 71 of 283 CIS agreements, including the Mir broadcaster (2023) and the 1992 visa-free agreement (Dec 2025). Grade 'neutral' because the CIS carries no operative posture toward Moldova; the cooling is Moldova's choice. Russia's foreign ministry called the move 'destructive'. Bond - none.
